verdict.rationale: Exa is an API product, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. The evidence shows no such spec: the probe found all common OpenAPI and Swagger paths return 404. The llms.txt index, markdown docs and MCP server are AI-readable documentation or integrations, not a machine-readable API contract. Confidence is medium because the probe checked only standard paths, so a spec hosted elsewhere in the docs cannot be ruled out.
